increment_paragraph: **SP9-PLUGIN-GUARDED-APPLICATION-FORMULAS (2026-11-23).** User decision 2026-11-20 (conditions are symbols, not sentences); user 2026-11-23: "Launch both", then, on the card's stop (all 14 symbols of the frozen plugin guarded sidecar were refused, not 7: the seven plugin_* prerequisites, lifted to their typed atoms' formulas, are not typed renderings), D1 A' (prefixed SP9 terms, environment implicit), D2 b (default_lifetime_valid states liveness only) and D3 I2 (a warrant term for refuted registration).
